column7: #3585 review: the SSO JIT default_role scope check ran on a pre-read outside the provisioning transaction and was skipped when that read failed, so the transaction granted the role install-wide unchecked (fail open; also stale against a concurrent narrowing). The check now runs on the transaction's own read before any write and a failed read refuses the provision (TestProvisionSSOUser_DefaultRoleNarrowedBeforeGrantIsRefused).
